## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->
This repository provides an interactive web chart that visualizes annual consumer price index (CPI) inflation for the United States, France, and Switzerland from 1900 to 2026. It focuses on the World War II period and the sharp post‑war inflation spike, letting users see how wartime price controls suppressed inflation and why a 20 % surge followed in 1947. The chart is built with React and Recharts and bundles all JavaScript dependencies locally, so it runs without any build step or external network requests. A live demo is hosted on GitHub Pages, making it easy to explore or embed the visualization. Historians, economists, educators, and anyone interested in economic history can start by opening the index.html file in a browser.
